description:
Returns all tasks. The number of results is limited by the `limit` parameter and additional results (if available)
will be available through the `next` URL present in the `Link` response header.

**[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**:
Permission to access the Confluence site ('Can use' global permission).
Only tasks that the user has permission to view will be returned.

parameters.name: body-format
parameters.description: The content format types to be returned in the `body` field of the response. If available, the representation will be available under a response field of the same name under the `body` field.

parameters.name: include-blank-tasks
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include blank tasks in the response. Defaults to `true`.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filters on the status of the task.

parameters.name: task-id
parameters.description: Filters on task ID. Multiple IDs can be specified.

parameters.name: space-id
parameters.description: Filters on the space ID of the task. Multiple IDs can be specified.

parameters.name: page-id
parameters.description: Filters on the page ID of the task. Multiple IDs can be specified. Note - page and blog post filters can be used in conjunction.

parameters.name: blogpost-id
parameters.description: Filters on the blog post ID of the task. Multiple IDs can be specified. Note - page and blog post filters can be used in conjunction.

parameters.name: created-by
parameters.description: Filters on the Account ID of the user who created this task. Multiple IDs can be specified.

parameters.name: assigned-to
parameters.description: Filters on the Account ID of the user to whom this task is assigned. Multiple IDs can be specified.

parameters.name: completed-by
parameters.description: Filters on the Account ID of the user who completed this task. Multiple IDs can be specified.

parameters.name: created-at-from
parameters.description: Filters on start of date-time range of task based on creation date (inclusive). Input is epoch time in milliseconds.

parameters.name: created-at-to
parameters.description: Filters on end of date-time range of task based on creation date (inclusive). Input is epoch time in milliseconds.

parameters.name: due-at-from
parameters.description: Filters on start of date-time range of task based on due date (inclusive). Input is epoch time in milliseconds.

parameters.name: due-at-to
parameters.description: Filters on end of date-time range of task based on due date (inclusive). Input is epoch time in milliseconds.

parameters.name: completed-at-from
parameters.description: Filters on start of date-time range of task based on completion date (inclusive). Input is epoch time in milliseconds.

parameters.name: completed-at-to
parameters.description: Filters on end of date-time range of task based on completion date (inclusive). Input is epoch time in milliseconds.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Used for pagination, this opaque cursor will be returned in the `next` URL in the `Link` response header. Use the relative URL in the `Link` header to retrieve the `next` set of results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of tasks per result to return. If more results exist, use the `Link` header to retrieve a relative URL that will return the next set of results.

200.description: Returned if the requested tasks are returned.

Link.description: This header contains URL(s) within angle brackets and a relation description for each URL, describing how the provided URL relates to the incoming request's URL. For example, rel="next" would be the URL necessary to get the next page of information. Example response header format: `Link: </wiki/api/v2/tasks?cursor=<opaque cursor token>>; rel="next", <https://site.atlassian.net/wiki>; rel="base"`

400.description: Returned if an invalid request is provided.

401.description:
Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing
from the request.
